acm_certificate_arn.description: ACM certificate ARN covering `domain`. Empty means the ALB serves plain HTTP; set means an HTTPS listener plus a 301 from port 80.

enable_cdn.description: Front the ALB with CloudFront so tenants without a certificate still get HTTPS. Ignored when acm_certificate_arn is set. Re-run this workflow manually with it unchecked to remove a distribution that is misbehaving — the ALB keeps serving either way.

docs_signer_secret_arn.description: ARN of the docs-signer Lambda's shared auth secret, written by the platform during onboarding (like llm_secret_arn — an ARN, not the secret value)

retrieval_min_score.description: Minimum cosine similarity a retrieved chunk must clear to be used as context. Empty uses the container default. Raise it to make the chatbot more willing to refuse, lower it if it refuses questions its documents can answer.
